g.text: C23 native-scope grace, joint root admission and whole-runtime learning
native frames and Scheme continuation lifetime are different
learn removal-before-quiescence; do not assume Gambit checkpoints qualify
learn stable slot and controlled runtime access; not API substitution
acquire before ClientData selection; interpreter thread owner required
selected handle identity retained across deletion
short rooted reservation; confirm exact commit before payload read
close new discovery; keep preselected old scopes alive
drain mutation reservation; active native grace can remain
definitive refusal or exact unknown ticket; no Scheme error retry
known delivery, no borrower, native grace, scanner and root retirement
optional transfer restrictions; preserve default shared Scheme semantics
reuse real processor threads, queues and stealing; diagnose remaining span
only materialize eligible parent continuation when parallelism is used; split/root model open
potentially lower task overhead; not actor heap isolation and not covered by native-scope proof
